label: Moonlight Coffee Store #2 proposal & quote request
hint: Drafts of a floor plan, a design proposal (Word) and a quote (Excel) are made
subject: Moonlight Coffee Store #2 design proposal and quote request
text:
Hello, this is Soyul Han from the Moonlight Coffee operations team.
We're opening Store #2 in Seongsu-dong, Seoul next March. The store is 12 m wide × 9 m deep (about 108 ㎡), and we need a hall with about 40 seats, an order and coffee bar, a bean storage room, a staff lounge and one restroom. We'd like the same warm wood tone as Store #1.
Could you send us a floor plan, a design proposal (Word) and a quote (Excel) by next Friday?
Thank you.
Best regards,
Soyul Han

label: Moonlight Coffee site measurement scheduling
hint: A reply to-do card appears on Home
subject: [Moonlight Coffee] Scheduling the on-site measurement for Store #2
text: Hello, this is the Moonlight Coffee operations team, writing about Store #2 in Seongsu-dong. Would an on-site measurement meeting at the store on November 3 at 2 PM work for you? If that time doesn't work, please suggest two or three times that do. We'll send the site address separately once you reply. Thank you.

label: Hanbit Events year-end party refreshments cost sheet
hint: A draft Excel quote is made
subject: Refreshments cost sheet for the year-end party
text: Hello, this is Daeun Kim from Hanbit Events. Could you send us an Excel file with the cost of snacks and drinks for our December year-end party (80 people), showing quantity, unit price and total for each item? We'd like to have it by this Friday.

label: Northwind tax invoice request

text: Hello, this is Haneul Kim from Northwind Systems. If you issue the tax invoice for the October maintenance fee of ₩3,300,000 (VAT included) within this week, we'll pay it on the 5th of next month.
